# Filao Networks Solutions

> Filao Networks Solutions is an enterprise and residential Internet Service Provider (ISP), managed IT services, and cybersecurity solutions company headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya. We engineer high-speed fiber optic connectivity, fixed wireless broadband, enterprise leased lines, 4K AI CCTV surveillance, cloud networking, and IoT telemetry across Nairobi and the larger East African region.

## Core Services & Connectivity

- [Residential Fiber](https://filaonetworks.com/services/residential-fiber): High-speed home fiber internet from 10 Mbps to 1 Gbps with 99.9% uptime, zero throttling, and low latency for streaming and remote work.
- [Dedicated Internet Access](https://filaonetworks.com/services/dedicated-internet): Symmetrical 1:1 uncontended leased line connectivity with 99.99% SLA guarantee and redundant fiber backbones for enterprise operations.
- [Wireless Broadband](https://filaonetworks.com/services/wireless-internet): Point-to-point and point-to-multipoint fixed wireless internet for underserved and semi-urban locations.
- [Street Hotspots](https://filaonetworks.com/services/street-hotspots): Public Wi-Fi captive portal infrastructure for malls, universities, business parks, and urban transit hubs.
- [Internet Solutions Overview](https://filaonetworks.com/services/internet-solutions): Full catalog of home, business, and enterprise connectivity packages.

## Security, Cloud & Infrastructure Services

- [CCTV & Video Surveillance](https://filaonetworks.com/services/cctv-security): AI-powered 4K surveillance cameras, perimeter intrusion detection, automated NVR/DVR storage, and 24/7 remote monitoring.
- [Access Control Systems](https://filaonetworks.com/services/access-control): Biometric scanners, RFID keycards, turnstiles, and automated boom barrier vehicle access systems.
- [Biometric Fencing](https://filaonetworks.com/services/biometric-fencing): Electric security fencing combined with biometric access sensors and alarm integrations.
- [Smart Doorbell Systems](https://filaonetworks.com/services/smart-doorbell): HD video intercoms, mobile app unlocking, and two-way audio for residential and corporate gates.
- [Network Design & Structured Cabling](https://filaonetworks.com/services/network-design): Certified Cisco and MikroTik LAN/WAN architecture, Cat6A/Fiber optic cabling, and server rack installations.
- [Network Security & SOC](https://filaonetworks.com/services/network-security): Next-Gen Firewalls (NGFW), VPN tunnels, DDoS protection, and intrusion prevention.
- [Managed Network Services](https://filaonetworks.com/services/managed-services): 24/7 NOC monitoring, automated failover management, and outsourced IT infrastructure support.
- [Cloud Network Solutions](https://filaonetworks.com/services/cloud-solutions): SD-WAN deployment, AWS/Azure hybrid cloud interconnects, and edge computing.
- [Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity](https://filaonetworks.com/services/disaster-recovery): Automated offsite backups, cloud replication, and rapid recovery orchestration.
- [IoT & Telemetry Integration](https://filaonetworks.com/services/iot-integration): Smart sensors, environmental monitoring, asset tracking, and industrial automation.

## Geographic Coverage & Coverage Areas

- [Coverage Map](https://filaonetworks.com/company/coverage-map): Interactive fiber and wireless coverage checking across Nairobi, Kasarani, Githurai, Kahawa Sukari, Kahawa Wendani, Ruiru, Roysambu, Thika Road corridor, and Kiambu County.
